lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2Cr6Co4O20 (reduced formula MgCr3(CoO5)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mcm (No. 143), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Cr, Co, and Mg centers, each surrounded by six O neighbors, while O centers show four geometric neighbors (Cr/Co/Mg). The octahedra connect primarily through corner- and edge-sharing Cr–Cr and Co–Mg contacts, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
